concept.title: Tour the Git Client Interface
concept.shortdesc: The Git Client spreads its work across three views, a menu, and contextual actions.

row.entry: Review changes, stage them, commit, and push or pull. This is your day-to-day workspace.
Explore the commit graph, inspect a commit, compare revisions, and see which files a commit changed.
Browse local and remote branches, and switch, create, merge, or delete them.
Run repository-level commands (clone, open, push, pull, fetch), and open Git Client preferences.
Work with Git directly from the Project view, the DITA Maps Manager, and the editor.
Configure how the Git Client behaves, including validation and AI options.

conbody.p: To open any of the three views, use WindowShow View, or open the view and use its toolbar to reach the other two.
